summary: The no_valid_comparison closure stands. All five computations reproduced, and all 53 files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes. The saved GEO HTML was a reCAPTCHA page. The GEO family SOFT and expression matrix independently confirmed all 35 registered nursed samples. The RNA paper reports separate effects by sex. The companion paper reports five overall MIA-versus-control expression ratios, but their RNA cohort and sex adjustment are unspecified. [RNA paper](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0292952) · [Companion paper, Table 2](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11826927/)
openIssues: The RNA paper reports 72 piglets. GEO lists 73 libraries in unequal groups, and the authors’ fitted sample roster remains unknown.
A selected-gene comparison could be reopened if the RNA libraries, nursing status and sex handling behind the five expression ratios are established.
